name: Forge Adept Spells
description:
When you reach an Artificer level specified in the Forge Adept Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Level 3: Armor of Agathys, Shield of Faith

Level 5: Spiritual Weapon, Warding Bond

Level 9: Beacon of Hope, Remove Curse

Level 13: Death Ward, Fire Shield

Level 17: Banishing Smite, Wall of Force
